name: Tōv Coffee
title: Tōv Coffee · Egyptian coffee on SE Hawthorne, Portland (concept)
description: Concept demo: Tōv Coffee menu, hours, location and ordering. Egyptian coffee and tea on SE Hawthorne Blvd, Portland.

hero.title: Egyptian coffee,
hero.sub: Cardamom espresso, rose mochas and sahlep. Since 2015, first in a red double-decker bus.

image.alt: Inside Tōv: purple walls, gold-framed paintings, low red floor cushions with Egyptian patterns and a round brass table.

menu.note: Tap a drink to add it. From the menu at the shop. Prices at the counter. Every drink is made by hand, so it can take up to 20 minutes.

extra.title: Pastries
extra.text: Egyptian pastries in the case by the counter.

locationsNote: Indoor seating on couches and floor cushions.

outsidePhoto.alt: Tōv's storefront on SE Hawthorne: purple trim, gold door, and the words Egyptian Coffee above the windows.

footer.line: Opened by Joseph Nazir in 2015 in a red double-decker bus on Hawthorne. Moved into this shop in 2023.
